By way of present application, prayer has been made for review/recalling of judgment dated 28.11.2016 passed in present RFA-6252- 2015.

2. Briefly stating, in the present case, some land owned by the applicants-appellants situated in the revenue estate of Village Ferozepur, District Palwal, came to be acquired vide notifications dated 15.06.2006 and 14.06.2007, issued under Sections 4 & 6, respectively of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 (for short, "1894 Act"), for the public purpose, namely, for the development and utilization as Transport Nagar, Sector 21, Palwal.

The Land Acquisition Collector had passed the award under Section 11 of the 1894 Act was passed on 09.06.2009, whereby, compensation @ Rs.16 lacs per acre was awarded in favour of the applicants- appellants(landowners) along with all other statutory benefits.

2.1. Dissatisfied with the LAC award, the applicants-appellants preferred references under Section 18 of the 1894 Act, which came to be disposed of with LAC No.387/2011, vide award dated 24.12.2011 by the ld. Reference Court, whereby, the compensation was enhanced to Rs.17 lacs per acre besides grant of other statutory benefits.
2.2. The aforesaid award passed by the ld.
Reference Court was 4 of 6 CM-2362-CI-2019 in RA-RF-41-2019 in/and RFA-6252-2015 (O&M) --5-- assailed by the applicant(s)-appellant(s) before this Court by way of present RFA-6252-2015.

On 28.11.2016, the present RFA was disposed of by this Court in terms of decision dated 10.12.2015 passed in RFA-1255-2014, titled as "Mukesh Kumar vs. State of Haryana and others" and the appeal in hand was dismissed.

In such circumstances apparently, the mistake of deciding the present appeal in terms of decision dated 10.12.2015 passed in RFA-1255-2014,
occurred on account of oversight.

In fact, the present appeal was to be disposed of in terms of RFA-5231 of 2014, titled as "Bhagwan Dass vs. State of Haryana and others", whereby the market value of the present acquisition relating to Sector 21, Palwal was determined @ Rs.22,80,000/- per acre, besides, grant of all other statutory benefits, which further stood enhanced by the Hon'ble Apex Court vide its decision dated 02.11.2017, passed in SLP (Civil) No.20674-2016, titled as "Adani Logistics Ltd. vs. Land Acquisition Collector and others", and the market value was re

5. In such circumstances, once the inadvertent error which occurred at the time of disposal of the aforementioned appeal on 28.11.2016 5 of 6 CM-2362-CI-2019 in RA-RF-41-2019 in/and RFA-6252-2015 (O&M) --6-- due to oversight and keeping in mind that the factum of mentioning of wrong sector and subsequently RFA number was never pointed out by the State Counsel, the same cannot be attributed to the applicants-appellants alone, as such, they cannot be made to suffer on that account.
6. Resultantly, in view of the aforesaid reasoning as well as in the given facts and circumstances, in order to do substantial justice to the parties and for grant of just & fair compensation as has already been awarded to the similarly situated landowners, the present review application is allowed and the decision dated 28.11.2016 passed by this Court in the present appeal, is hereby recalled and the appeal is ordered to be restored on merits to its original number.
RFA-6252-2015 (O&M)
1.
Learned counsel for the parties are ad-idem
that the matter in issue as regards the determination of enhanced compensation is squarely covered by the decision rendered by by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Adani Logistics Ltd. case (supra).

2. Accordingly, the present appeal is disposed of in terms of the above mentioned two decisions dated 10.12.2015 passed by this Court in Bhagwan Dass's case (supra) (RFA-5231-2014) and dated 02.11.2017, passed by Hon'ble the Supreme Court in Adani Logistics Ltd.'s case (supra) and the appellants are entitled for market value @ Rs.32,30,000/- per acre in favour of the applicants-appellants (landowners) along with all other statutory benefits and interest, including the interest on solatium.
3. Pending misc. application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
